archiveTitle: Evening Brief | S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 Major Expansion and 2.0 Update Now Live

entries.headline: Dated for November 26
entries.summary: Toei Animation and Studio51 announced the series' first game will launch on Switch and PC, with support for Japanese and English. The title connects the 2014 film with the 2026 new film 'Heart Resonance', featuring branching choices leading to multiple endings.
entries.verification: Press release and Steam store page both accessible; platform, language, and release date are consistent.

mediaAlts.alt: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel official announcement image for November 26 release

entries.headline: Steam demo now available
entries.summary: The demo begins with the prologue where an editor is trapped inside a manuscript, allowing exploration between a 2D ink-wash world and a 3D mansion; completing the main portion unlocks an extra boss challenge.
entries.verification: Steam directly offers the demo download; 4Gamer used to supplement opening time.
entries.timeNote: Converted from Japanese media release time

mediaAlts.alt: Chronoscript: The Endless End official image for Steam demo availability

entries.headline: Steam Early Access now live
entries.summary: MELTCLOCK's roguelite factory sim is now purchasable. The launch version offers three sponsor company combinations and dozens of hours of content; the team plans at least six months of Early Access.
entries.verification: Steam shows August 20, Phoenixx Japan announcement records August 21; regional differences retained.
entries.timeNote: Converted from Japanese media release time

mediaAlts.alt: Lazy Witch’s Factory official image for Steam Early Access launch

entries.headline: Major expansion and 2.0 update now live
entries.summary: Official Steam news confirms the major expansion and free 2.0 update are released. The expansion adds two regions and dozens of hours of content; 2.0 migrates the engine to UE 5.5.4 and adjusts lighting, AI, and ecology.
entries.verification: Release fact confirmed; official site, Steam, and Japan announcement lack unified timezone notation.

mediaAlts.alt: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl official image for major expansion and 2.0 update release

entries.headline: Confirmed for Tokyo Game Show 2026
entries.summary: NC confirmed that the fantasy RPG developed by Dynamis One will have its own booth at Makuhari Messe from September 17 to 21; operational details and schedule will be announced on a later dedicated page.
entries.verification: Official account original post accessible; two media outlets used to supplement booth and time information.
entries.timeNote: Converted from Korean media release time

entries.headline: Confirmed for Netflix premiere on October 20
entries.summary: This round verified CD PROJEKT RED's press release and Netflix's official trailer, confirming the second season is a standalone 10-episode story. The original announcement predates this window, so it is included as a delayed catch-up.
entries.verification: Primary pages verified; this is a catch-up item, not counted as new news in the current window.
entries.timeNote: Official pages only list the date
